We need a CloudFormation template that creates the AWSQS::Kubernetes::Helm resource type in the CloudFormation registry for managing Helm chart deployments on EKS clusters, using a custom resource handler package stored in an S3 bucket, and provisions the necessary IAM roles with permissions for Lambda execution, VPC networking, EKS management, and CloudWatch Logs, along with registering the resource version and setting it as the default version.

We need a CloudFormation template that creates a regional REST API for an NIH Grants backend, secured with a Cognito user pool authorizer where the user pool ARN is accepted as an input parameter with a placeholder default, and the template must include an AWS::ApiGateway::Account resource configured with a CloudWatch logs role ARN, along with POST endpoints at the exact paths /search, /scrapeURLContext, /modelPrompts, /checkTemplateStatus, /listS3Artifacts, /templateGen, and /nihrSearch, where the /templateGen endpoint integrates directly with an SQS queue (using the IAM role for sending messages) and the /nihrSearch endpoint proxies to the public NIH RePORTER API, all with CORS support, and the template must provision a new SQS queue with a dead-letter queue, a KMS key for encrypting both queues and API Gateway logs, the necessary IAM roles for API Gateway to send messages to the queue and push logs to CloudWatch, and deploy the API to a Dev stage with an API key and a usage plan that enforces a quota of 5000 requests per month, a rate limit of 10 requests per second, and a burst limit of 20.

We need a CloudFormation template that creates a Cognito user pool for an application called "researchapp" and "AgentCore", with MFA set to optional using software tokens, email as username and auto-verified, and two user groups (admin and customer) where the admin group has higher precedence. We need a CloudFormation template that creates two separate Cognito authentication setups for a PiBot project: one for the main web application and one for IoT trusted user provisioning. The main web app setup should include a user pool, a user pool client, an identity pool that allows unauthenticated access, and IAM roles for authenticated and unauthenticated users that grant permissions for common IoT operations, Kinesis Video streaming actions, Rekognition label detection, and standard Cognito and mobile analytics actions. We need a CloudFormation template that creates a scheduled workflow to automatically close AWS Organization accounts that are tagged with the key "organizations:account-closure" and value "REQUESTED". We need a CloudFormation template that creates the shared IAM roles and instance profiles required by the Amazon EKS Quick Start stacks in our account, using the prefix "eks-quickstart" for all role names and storing parameter values under the SSM path "/quickstart/amazon-eks". We need a CloudFormation template that creates an AWS AppSync GraphQL API named "WS-API" with API_KEY authentication, designed to support real-time WebSocket communication through subscriptions and mutations. We need a CloudFormation template that creates a Cognito User Pool for an AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo, with a public app client configured for SRP and refresh token authentication, three user groups (team-alpha with precedence 10, team-beta with precedence 20, and admin with precedence 1), and a custom resource Lambda function that seeds six test users, all sharing the same demo password value hardcoded in the seeding logic (for example, Demo1234!) so the template is fully self-contained: alice@demo.local and bob@demo.local in team-alpha with a custom role attribute of member, charlie@demo.local in team-alpha with a custom role attribute of team_admin, dave@demo.local in team-beta with a custom role attribute of member, eve@demo.local in team-beta with a custom role attribute of team_admin, and admin@demo.local in the admin group with a custom role attribute of admin. We need a CloudFormation template that creates a Route53 hosted zone and ACM certificates for the domain "smartcumulus.org" (configurable via a parameter) to support external Cumulus URLs, including certificates for the root domain, www, aggregator, staging.aggregator, dev.aggregator, api, staging.api, and dev.api subdomains, all validated via DNS using the hosted zone, and outputting the hosted zone ID and certificate ARNs for each.

We need a CloudFormation template that creates a Route 53 public hosted zone for the domain passengerlist.org, and provisions all necessary DNS record sets including TXT records for SPF and site verification, MX records for G Suite email with standard priority values, a DMARC TXT record on the _dmarc subdomain, A and AAAA alias records pointing the root domain and multiple subdomains (www, departures, join, athena, feed) to their respective CloudFront distributions using the standard CloudFront alias hosted zone ID, CNAME records for Zendesk mail routing, DKIM verification, and Squarespace domain verification, and CNAME records for AWS ACM certificate validation across several subdomains, using dynamically fetched or referenced values where those resources would be provisioned separately.

We need a CloudFormation template that creates IAM roles and managed policies for an e-commerce serverless architecture, including a role for a Lambda function that reads from an SQS queue named `POC-Queue-{env}` and writes to a DynamoDB table named `ecommerce-orders-{env}`, a second role for a Lambda function that reads from DynamoDB Streams on that same table and publishes to an SNS topic named `POC-Topic-{env}`, and a third role for API Gateway to send messages to the SQS queue, along with the necessary managed policies for these actions and a basic Lambda execution policy for CloudWatch logs, all parameterized by an Environment parameter with a default of `dev` and allowed values `dev`, `test`, `prod`, and with the role ARNs exported for cross-stack references.

We need a CloudFormation template that creates a Route 53 hosted zone for 'theworld.org' and populates it with a comprehensive set of DNS records to support a production media environment. Finally, include CNAME records for public feeds, Autodiscover endpoints, Zendesk mail routing, and AWS ACM validation records for the various subdomains, utilizing dummy values or parameters where appropriate for external endpoints and validation hashes.

We need a CloudFormation template that creates a VPC infrastructure for OpenSearch cross-region resilience, deployable in both regions, with a configurable environment name (default "production"), a VPC CIDR of 10.0.0.0/16, three private subnets (10.0.1.0/24, 10.0.2.0/24, 10.0.3.0/24) and three public subnets (10.0.101.0/24, 10.0.102.0/24, 10.0.103.0/24) each in separate Availability Zones, an Internet Gateway, and an optional NAT Gateway setup that can be either a single NAT Gateway (cost-effective) or one per AZ for high availability, with the default being single; the template should also enable VPC Flow Logs with a 7-day retention period sent to CloudWatch Logs, and export all subnet IDs, VPC ID, and NAT Gateway IDs as stack outputs.

We need a CloudFormation template that creates the required IAM roles for SageMaker project templates, allowing each role's creation to be controlled independently via a parameter that defaults to "YES" except for the launch role and use role which default to "NO", and each role should be scoped to the /service-role/ path with a maximum session duration of one hour, with the launch role and use role having a deletion policy of Retain, and the template must output all eleven role ARNs, including the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsExecutionRole attached to the AmazonSageMakerFullAccess managed policy, the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsLaunchRole attached to the AmazonSageMakerAdmin-ServiceCatalogProductsServiceRolePolicy, the AmazonSageMakerServiceCatalogProductsUseRole attached to the AmazonEC2ReadOnlyAccess managed policy plus an inline policy granting specific permissions across SageMaker, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, CodeBuild, CodeCommit, CodePipeline, EC2 (including network interface management for VPC-connected jobs), ECR, Events, Firehose, Glue, IAM, Lambda, Logs, S3, Step Functions, CodeStar Connections, KMS, and SSM, and the remaining service roles for CloudFormation, CodeBuild, CodePipeline, Events, API Gateway, Firehose, Glue, and Lambda each having their respective AWS-managed service role policies attached.

We need a CloudFormation template that creates an ECS service on Fargate using the CodeDeploy blue/green deployment controller, with the service referencing imported resources from existing stacks for the VPC, cluster, ALB, and task definition, the service set to a desired count of one task, the container named "book-app", the service named "service-book-blue-green", and automatic scaling that adjusts the desired count between 1 and 4 based on average CPU utilization targeting 80 percent.

We need a CloudFormation template that creates an Amazon DataZone domain with a configurable domain name defaulting to "cookbookChapter11", along with two projects named SalesPublisher and MarketingConsumer to represent producer and consumer teams, and the required IAM roles for domain execution, data access (including Glue, Redshift, and Secrets Manager permissions), and provisioning, plus an environment blueprint configuration for the DefaultDataWarehouse blueprint enabled in the current region.

We need a CloudFormation template that creates an AWS Amplify application for the "Laravel AWS Book" GitHub repository (https://github.com/petrabarus/laravel-aws-book) with a "main" branch configured for automatic builds and pull request previews, including an IAM role for the Amplify service to assume, and provisioning a new Secrets Manager secret named "GITHUB_OAUTH_TOKEN" to store the GitHub OAuth token, with the region defaulting to us-east-1.

We need a CloudFormation template that creates a self-service Cognito user pool for testing JWT authentication flows with an AgentCore Gateway and MCP server, where users can sign up using their email address and verify themselves without any admin intervention by enabling self-service signup with email verification, and the pool should include a hosted UI domain for signup and login pages, a resource server with identifier "api" and custom scopes named "mcp" and "gateway", a public web client that supports authorization code with PKCE along with explicit auth flows for USER_PASSWORD_AUTH and USER_SRP_AUTH for programmatic testing with token validity set to 60 minutes for access and ID tokens and 30 days for refresh tokens, and two separate machine-to-machine clients that use the client credentials grant with the appropriate custom scopes for gateway and MCP server authentication, each with a generated client secret and token validity of 60 minutes for access and ID tokens and 1 day for refresh tokens, and the template should accept comma-delimited parameters for callback and logout URLs with sensible localhost defaults.

We need a CloudFormation template that creates a self-contained Kinesis Firehose delivery stream configured for DirectPut delivery, which compresses incoming data using GZIP and buffers it for up to 900 seconds or 128 MB before writing to a newly provisioned S3 bucket under a "raw/MyKinesisFirehose/" prefix; the stack must also create that S3 bucket, a dedicated CloudWatch log group with a 14-day retention policy and a log stream named "firehose" to capture delivery stream logs, an IAM role that allows the Firehose service to assume it and grants permissions for S3 PutObject, GetObject, AbortMultipartUpload, GetBucketLocation, ListBucket, and ListBucketMultipartUploads on the target bucket and its prefix path as well as full CloudWatch Logs access on the created log group, and a CloudWatch alarm that monitors the DeliveryToS3.DataFreshness metric every 60 seconds with a threshold of 1800 seconds and treats missing data as not breaching.

We need a CloudFormation template that deploys an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway infrastructure for MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration to support an AI agent for protein variant effect prediction. The template should not provision the backend compute or authentication providers; instead, it must dynamically resolve existing configuration from SSM Parameter Store. Create an IAM role for the 'bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com' service that grants permission to invoke a Lambda function (retrieving the Lambda ARN dynamically from SSM) and store this new IAM role's ARN in a standard SSM parameter. Provision the AgentCore Gateway configured with a custom JWT authorizer that dynamically references a Cognito discovery URL and client ID from SSM. Include parameters for the project name (defaulting to 'protein-engineering'), gateway description, and an optional gateway name that auto-generates from the project name if left blank.

We need a CloudFormation template that creates an AWS App Runner service for a multi-tenant QuickSight dashboard application, provisioning a new ECR repository and container image within the same account and region, with auto-deployments enabled and a health check at the /status path on port 8080, while also creating IAM roles: a build role with permissions to access ECR (including GetAuthorizationToken and image pull operations) and a task role with permissions to call Directory Service and QuickSight APIs (such as CreateNamespace, CreateDataSet, RegisterUser, and related actions) to support tenant provisioning, and configuring the App Runner service with runtime environment variables including ALLOW_IP_RANGE set to 0.0.0.0/0, the AWS region and account ID, a dummy email placeholder, an admin user name, and template, dataset, datasource, database, table, and filter column identifiers for the QuickSight integration, with the template being fully self-contained and outputting the generated image URI and the App Runner service URL.

We need a CloudFormation template that creates a regional Web Application Firewall (WAFv2) for an Application Load Balancer. The stack must use a customizable prefix parameter (defaulting to 'sera', 3-21 lowercase characters) to name resources, and must accept two additional parameters for external dependencies: the ARN of an existing Application Load Balancer and the ARN of an existing KMS key. Associate the WAF with the provided ALB parameter, and configure CloudWatch logging (with 10-year retention, encrypted using the provided KMS key parameter), ensuring a logging filter is applied to only keep entries where the action was COUNT.

We need a CloudFormation template that creates a self-contained AWS Cognito authentication infrastructure for an application called "nih-grants", including a user pool with multi-factor authentication enabled and advanced security mode enforced, an identity pool that supports both authenticated and unauthenticated identities (with unauthenticated access disabled by default), and two app clients (one for web and one for general use) with a 30-day refresh token validity. The user pool must enforce a password policy requiring a minimum length of 11 characters, including uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols, with temporary passwords valid for 7 days, and email verification should use a confirmation code with the subject "Your verification code" and message "Your verification code is {####}". The authenticated IAM role should include an inline policy granting S3 object-level permissions (put, get, delete, and tagging) on a bucket named with the pattern "nih-grants-context-{region}-{accountId}", KMS GenerateDataKey and Decrypt permissions restricted to requests using the alias "nih-grants-s3-key", and API Gateway WebSocket connect permission on any API in the account and region.
